quote.text: …till about thirty Dajjals (liars) appear, and each one of them will claim that he is Allah’s Messenger.

shots.framing: HOOK. Wide: the city hall burning at night, a crowd of silhouettes in front
shots.vo_markup: The *fire* started at midnight.
shots.vo: The fire started at midnight.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The city hall (civic building: wide steps, columns, clock tower) engulfed in flames; dark crowd silhouettes with raised arms; embers rising
shots.notes: Frame 0 already burning and moving. Flames, smoke, embers on ones; crowd on twos. Flames flare on "fire". No bodies, no injuries.

shots.framing: Wide: the smoking ruins of city hall at sunrise, grey ash everywhere
shots.vo_markup: By sunrise, city hall was *gone.*
shots.vo: By sunrise, city hall was gone.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Blackened columns and a collapsed clock tower; a lone street sweeper silhouette pushing ash
shots.notes: Smoke drifts (ones). Sweeper (twos). Last column visible clearly on "gone".

shots.framing: Close: two men at a night coffee stall leaning in to whisper, looking up at the lit city hall on the hill
shots.vo_markup: Three days earlier, it was only a *whisper.*
shots.vo: Three days earlier, it was only a whisper.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Two profiles whispering; the lit city hall small in the background
shots.notes: Callback to the end of Chapter 2. Lean-in on "whisper".

shots.framing: Close: a hand spray-painting big letters on a wall: "HE SOLD OUR WATER"
shots.vo_markup: The mayor had sold the city's *water.*
shots.vo: The mayor had sold the city's water.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Spray can, paint drips, the letters appearing
shots.notes: The last word of the graffiti completes on "water". Text exactly: HE SOLD OUR WATER.

shots.framing: Medium: a wall where copies of the same poster multiply (a mayor silhouette, no face, crossed out in red)
shots.vo_markup: There was no *proof.* There didn't need to be.
shots.vo: There was no proof. There didn't need to be.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Posters appearing one after another until the wall is covered
shots.notes: A new poster slaps on every half-second; "proof" lands on a big red X. The mayor is a generic silhouette in a suit, no face, no party colours.

shots.framing: High wide: a huge boulevard completely filled with people
shots.vo_markup: By the second day, a *million* people filled the streets.
shots.vo: By the second day, a million people filled the streets.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: An ocean of tiny figures, flags without symbols, smoke flares
shots.notes: Crowd motion on twos (shimmer of heads/arms), camera on ones. "million": the crowd surges.

shots.framing: Low angle: a flyover with long cloth banners hanging, people on top
shots.vo_markup: Banners hung from every *bridge.*
shots.vo: Banners hung from every bridge.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Banners reading "STEP DOWN" and "HE IS INNOCENT" (two sides)
shots.notes: Banner cloth waves (ones). Text exactly: STEP DOWN / HE IS INNOCENT.

shots.framing: Medium: a family at a dinner table; the father stands and points at a TV in the background
shots.vo_markup: Half the city wanted him *gone.*
shots.vo: Half the city wanted him gone.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Father shouting and pointing; plates; TV glow in the back (no readable screen)
shots.notes: Point on "gone".

shots.framing: Reverse: the grown son stands up across the table; the mother between them
shots.vo_markup: The other half swore he was *innocent.*
shots.vo: The other half swore he was innocent.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Son arguing back; mother reaching out to both
shots.notes: Son slams the table on "innocent".

shots.framing: Close: a hand throwing a lit bottle in an arc toward the dark city hall
shots.vo_markup: On the third night, someone threw the first *flame.*
shots.vo: On the third night, someone threw the first flame.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: A silhouette arm and the arc of fire across the frame
shots.notes: Throw on "flame". Stylised, no instructional detail, no victims.

shots.framing: Medium: an empty mayor's office, the chair turned away, papers blowing from an open window
shots.vo_markup: The mayor *vanished.*
shots.vo: The mayor vanished.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The empty chair; papers drifting
shots.notes: Papers lift on "vanished".

shots.framing: Wide: an empty road at night, the red tail lights of one car disappearing; a car door left open in the foreground
shots.vo_markup: No one knows if he ran… or if he was *taken.*
shots.vo: No one knows if he ran… or if he was taken.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Tail lights shrinking; the open door
shots.notes: Tail lights vanish on "taken".

shots.framing: Wide: the same boulevard now empty under curfew, a burnt car, a stray dog, litter
shots.vo_markup: For two days, the city had no one.
shots.vo: For two days, the city had no one.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Emptiness; the dog trotting
shots.notes: Wind-blown litter (ones), dog (twos).

shots.framing: Three quick hard cuts inside the shot: a dry tap dripping once; an empty bakery shelf; a mother hugging her child in a silent queue
shots.vo_markup: No *water.* No *bread.* No *answers.*
shots.vo: No water. No bread. No answers.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Each beat lands on its word
shots.notes: Cut 1 on "water", cut 2 on "bread", cut 3 on "answers".

shots.framing: Wide: a lone silhouette walking out of drifting smoke toward camera, backlit by the low sun
shots.vo_markup: Then, on the fifth day, a man walked out of the *ashes.*
shots.vo: Then, on the fifth day, a man walked out of the ashes.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: A faceless backlit man in plain clothes emerging from smoke
shots.notes: Fully emerges on "ashes". He is always backlit or seen from behind: NO face, ever.

shots.framing: Close: his dusty sandals stepping over rubble; then his empty hands
shots.vo_markup: No name. No past.
shots.vo: No name. No past.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Feet and hands only
shots.notes: Simple, slow, deliberate steps (twos).

shots.framing: Medium: the man (from behind) handing bread to a child; people start gathering around him
shots.vo_markup: He handed out *bread.* He spoke softly.
shots.vo: He handed out bread. He spoke softly.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The child taking the bread; gathering crowd
shots.notes: Handover on "bread".

shots.framing: Medium-close: faces of listeners lit by warm light, nodding slowly
shots.vo_markup: Everything he said sounded *true.*
shots.vo: Everything he said sounded true.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Several listeners (simple faces) nodding
shots.notes: Nods land on "true".

shots.framing: Wide: a stadium at night, completely full, floodlights blazing
shots.vo_markup: By the seventh day, the stadium was *full.*
shots.vo: By the seventh day, the stadium was full.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The bowl of the stadium packed with people; a small stage in the centre
shots.notes: Floodlights snap on bank by bank, last one on "full".

shots.framing: Low wide: the man on the stage, a tiny backlit silhouette, arms open; giant screens behind show only his silhouette
shots.vo_markup: And he told them God had *sent* him.
shots.vo: And he told them God had sent him.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The silhouette with open arms; the huge screens
shots.notes: Arms open on "sent". No face on the screens.

shots.framing: Wide: a wave of people kneeling across the stands; some remain standing, frozen
shots.vo_markup: Half the city fell to its *knees.*
shots.vo: Half the city fell to its knees.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The kneeling wave rolling through the crowd
shots.notes: Wave passes the centre on "knees".

shots.framing: Medium: one old man standing still among the kneeling crowd, looking away from the stage
shots.vo_markup: The Prophet warned that before the Hour, around thirty liars would come, each claiming to be a messenger of God.
shots.vo: The Prophet warned that before the Hour, around thirty liars would come, each claiming to be a messenger of God.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The standing old man (peci, plain shirt) among kneeling backs
shots.notes: QUOTE overlay on this shot (top ~15–40%): keep the upper area dark and calm.

shots.framing: Wide: a highway at dawn, a long column of followers walking toward another city skyline; at a roadside stall an old radio plays
shots.vo_markup: The next morning, the neighboring city heard his *name.*
shots.vo: The next morning, the neighboring city heard his name.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The column of walkers; the distant skyline
shots.notes: The radio crackles on "name". No phone.

shots.framing: TITLE CARD on black
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: "THE MAN FROM NOWHERE" + "CHAPTER 3 · THE LAST DAYS"
shots.notes: Same design as EP02 S25 (copy).
